tests.description: ValidatePlanQueue accepts entries with kind "code", kind "ui", and no kind field (defaulting to code).

items.name: Add UIImplementingState and UIBatchState types
items.description: Define the dedicated state structs for the phase (three round counters, three eval histories, handed-off artifacts, per-loop force-accept flags), wire them into ForgeState, and add a constructor.

Add UIImplementing *UIImplementingState `json:"ui_implementing,omitempty"` to ForgeState.
Add NewUIImplementingState() next to NewImplementingState (state.go:197-201).
Reuse EvalRecord and LayerRef as-is. Add constructor + JSON round-trip tests.

A ForgeState carrying a populated UIImplementing with all three round counters and histories round-trips through Save/Load unchanged.

items.name: Render ui_implementing advance and status output

steps: Add printUIImplementingOutput (switch over the ten states) mirroring printImplementingOutput (output.go:685-1067); Phase line reads ui_implementing; add Loop/Round lines and per-state App/Steps/Tests/Run lines per the spec Outputs section.

Render COMMIT terminal item status, the DONE per-loop round totals, and the user_guided STOP line in ORIENT.
Add PhaseUIImplementing cases to PrintAdvanceOutput (29-47), CurrentEvalMode (17-26, loop-by-state), phaseConfig (1639-1652), and printProgressLine (1656-1696).

tests.description: QA_TEST advance output shows Phase ui_implementing, Loop qa, the App launch/url, and the Steps step-list path; UI_REFINE shows the QA report path and refine action.
When CurrentBatch.HandedOffArtifacts is non-empty, the rendered output includes a Review: line listing each artifact before the Action line.

items.name: Render QA and e2e eval context
items.description: Implement PrintUIQAEvalOutput and PrintUIE2EEvalOutput that embed the UI evaluator prompts and assemble the application, step-list, report, handoff, and previous-evaluation sections per eval_mode.
steps: Add PrintUIQAEvalOutput: header, --- QA EVALUATOR INSTRUCTIONS --- (embed evaluators.UIQAEval), --- APPLICATION --- (launch/url/ready timeout/Driver=Playwright MCP), --- ITEMS TO QA ---, --- STEP LIST OUTPUT --- (all modes), --- REPORT OUTPUT --- (report mode; direct=correct-directly; conversational omitted), --- HANDOFF --- (all modes; report/direct list report+step-list, conversational step-list only), --- PREVIOUS EVALUATIONS --- on later rounds.

Add PrintUIE2EEvalOutput: header, --- E2E EVALUATOR INSTRUCTIONS --- (embed evaluators.UIE2EEval), --- E2E SUITE --- (step list, test command, test dir, Runner=Playwright test runner), --- REPORT OUTPUT --- and --- HANDOFF --- (report mode only), previous evaluations on later rounds.
Route PhaseUIImplementing EVALUATE through the existing printImplementingEval in PrintEvalOutput (1702-1711); QA_TEST/E2E_VERIFY to the new functions.
Source config from s.Config.UIImplementing.App/E2E; workspace paths under <domain>/.forgectl_workspace/ui_plan/. Add tests.

tests.description: PrintUIQAEvalOutput embeds the QA prompt and shows the APPLICATION url, the STEP LIST OUTPUT path, and a HANDOFF section in every eval_mode.
PrintUIE2EEvalOutput embeds the e2e prompt and shows the E2E SUITE step-list path, test command, and test dir; the REPORT OUTPUT and HANDOFF sections appear only in report mode.
Round 2+ QA/e2e eval output includes a PREVIOUS EVALUATIONS section listing prior verdicts and report paths.

items.name: ui_implementing core state machine (spine + code loop)
items.description: Implement advanceUIImplementing and the spine handlers: ORIENT batch selection with three-counter reset, one-at-a-time IMPLEMENT, the code EVALUATE loop into QA_TEST, COMMIT terminal marking, and DONE.
steps: Add case PhaseUIImplementing to the Advance dispatch (advance.go:24-38) calling advanceUIImplementing.

Implement advanceUIImplementing as a switch over states; reuse loadPlan/savePlan/selectBatch/itemUnblocked/setItemPasses/incrementItemRounds/allLayerItemsTerminal/allLayersComplete against s.UIImplementing.
ORIENT: select batch, create UIBatchState with eval_round/qa_round/e2e_round=0, present first item.
IMPLEMENT: mirror advanceImplFromImplement (mark done; last item increments item rounds and -> EVALUATE).
Code EVALUATE: replicate advanceImplFromEvaluate using config.UIImplementing.Eval; PASS&>=min -> QA_TEST (qa_round=1); below-min/FAIL<max -> IMPLEMENT; FAIL>=max -> set CodeForceAccepted -> QA_TEST.

COMMIT: mark items passed iff no loop force-accepted else failed; archive batch into UILayerHistory; -> ORIENT or DONE. DONE handling mirrors implementing (interleaved -> phase shift; summary adds qa/e2e totals).
Add advance tests + a newUIImplementingState helper.

tests.description: ORIENT selects the first batch, transitions to IMPLEMENT, and resets eval_round/qa_round/e2e_round to 0.
Code EVALUATE PASS at >= eval.min_rounds transitions to QA_TEST with qa_round 1; FAIL at eval.max_rounds force-accepts and still transitions to QA_TEST flagged code-force-accepted.
After all three loops, COMMIT marks items passed when none force-accepted and DONE transitions to PHASE_SHIFT (ui_implementing -> planning) when interleaved and the planning queue is non-empty.

items.name: QA loop transitions (QA_TEST / UI_REFINE)
items.description: Implement the QA placement loop with its own round budget and force-accept, and enforce the QA step-list presence invariant on both exits toward E2E_AUTHOR.
steps: QA_TEST: require --verdict (and --eval-report in qa report mode); increment qa_round, append qa_evals; PASS&>=qa.min -> E2E_AUTHOR; below-min/FAIL<max -> UI_REFINE; FAIL>=qa.max -> set QAForceAccepted -> E2E_AUTHOR.
On both QA exits toward E2E_AUTHOR, require the step-list file <domain>/.forgectl_workspace/ui_plan/qa/batch-N-steps.json to exist; if absent, reject naming the path (exit 1), stay QA_TEST.
Read the step list only to confirm presence and count scenarios; a zero-scenario list is valid and logs a WARN.
UI_REFINE: always -> QA_TEST, increment qa_round.
Add transition tests including the step-list-absent rejections.

tests.description: QA_TEST FAIL below qa.max_rounds transitions to UI_REFINE; UI_REFINE advance returns to QA_TEST with qa_round incremented.
QA_TEST PASS at >= qa.min_rounds with a step-list file present transitions to E2E_AUTHOR.
Advancing out of QA_TEST toward E2E_AUTHOR (PASS at min or FAIL force-accept at max) with the step-list file absent is rejected naming the expected path; state remains QA_TEST.

items.name: E2E loop transitions (E2E_AUTHOR / E2E_VERIFY / E2E_REMEDIATE)
items.description: Implement the bridging E2E_AUTHOR state and the e2e verification loop with its own round budget and force-accept, terminating each batch into COMMIT.
steps: E2E_AUTHOR: no verdict; always -> E2E_VERIFY, increment e2e_round to 1 (zero-scenario step list still advances).

E2E_VERIFY: require --verdict (and --eval-report in e2e report mode); increment e2e_round, append e2e_evals; PASS&>=e2e.min -> COMMIT; below-min/FAIL<max -> E2E_REMEDIATE; FAIL>=e2e.max -> set E2EForceAccepted -> COMMIT.
E2E_REMEDIATE: always -> E2E_VERIFY, increment e2e_round.
Ensure COMMIT terminal marking (in advance.core) observes E2EForceAccepted alongside the other two force-accept flags.
Add transition tests including the empty-step-list vacuous pass and independent-round-budget cases.

tests.description: E2E_AUTHOR advances to E2E_VERIFY (e2e_round 1); E2E_VERIFY FAIL below e2e.max transitions to E2E_REMEDIATE; E2E_REMEDIATE returns to E2E_VERIFY with e2e_round incremented.
E2E_VERIFY PASS at >= e2e.min_rounds with no loop force-accepted transitions to COMMIT with items passed; FAIL at e2e.max transitions to COMMIT with items failed.
A zero-scenario step list passes the e2e loop vacuously (E2E_AUTHOR -> E2E_VERIFY PASS at min rounds), and the three loops count/bound their rounds independently given different per-loop max_rounds.

items.name: Route phase shift by plan kind
items.description: Make the planning->implementation and implementation->implementation domain-boundary phase shifts route to implementing or ui_implementing by the plan's kind, validating UI config keys when entering ui_implementing.
steps: In advancePhaseShift (advance.go:803-973), at the planning->implementation block (~872-911), read the active plan's Kind: ui -> set Phase=PhaseUIImplementing, code/absent -> PhaseImplementing.

When entering ui_implementing, validate the four required keys (app.launch_command, app.url, e2e.test_command, e2e.test_dir) non-empty; if any empty, print errors naming each and remain at PHASE_SHIFT.
Initialize state via NewUIImplementingState and add passes:pending/rounds:0 to plan.json items (same loop as implementing).
Apply the same kind routing at the implementation->implementation domain boundary (~921) for the next plan.
Add phase-shift routing tests (kind ui, kind code/absent, missing-config rejection).

tests.description: planning->implementation PHASE_SHIFT with active plan kind:ui and non-empty UI config sets phase ui_implementing/state ORIENT and mutates plan.json items; kind:code or absent sets phase implementing.
planning->implementation PHASE_SHIFT with kind:ui and an empty required UI config key prints the missing key and remains at PHASE_SHIFT.
In all-planning-first mode the implementation->implementation domain boundary routes the next plan by its kind (code->implementing, ui->ui_implementing).

items.name: init --phase ui_implementing
items.description: Accept ui_implementing as an init phase, validate the required UI config keys, and build the ui_implementing state from a plan.json identical to the implementing input.
steps: Add "ui_implementing": true to the validPhases map (init.go:38) and update the error message and --phase flag help (init.go:27,40).

Add case state.PhaseUIImplementing in the phase switch (init.go:81-189): reject if any of the four required UI keys is empty (naming each), else validate plan.json, add passes/rounds, and build state via state.NewUIImplementingState.
Add a case to phaseRoundConfig (init.go:222-236) returning UIImplementing batch + eval min/max.
Add command tests.

tests.description: init --phase ui_implementing with valid config and plan.json creates state with phase ui_implementing, state ORIENT, and plan.json items carrying passes/rounds.
init --phase ui_implementing with any one of the four required UI config keys empty exits 1 naming the missing key.
init --phase planning rejects a plan-queue entry whose kind is an invalid value, naming the entry and value.

items.name: Wire advance/eval for the new evaluator states
items.description: Make --verdict/--eval-report valid in QA_TEST and E2E_VERIFY, route the eval command to the QA/e2e/code eval output in ui_implementing, and treat ui_implementing DONE as terminal.
steps: Add StateQATest and StateE2EVerify to validateAdvanceFlags.validStates (advance.go:218-227) and printAdvanceWarnings.evalStates (234-238); add a PhaseUIImplementing branch selecting the loop eval_mode by current state for the --eval-report warning.
Add PhaseUIImplementing && StateDone to isTerminalState (advance.go:185-209).

In runEval (eval.go:32-48) add cases: ui_implementing+EVALUATE -> PrintEvalOutput; +QA_TEST -> PrintUIQAEvalOutput; +E2E_VERIFY -> PrintUIE2EEvalOutput; any other ui_implementing state -> error naming valid states.
Add command tests.

tests.description: forgectl eval in ui_implementing QA_TEST emits the QA context and in E2E_VERIFY emits the e2e context; --verdict is accepted in both states.
forgectl eval in ui_implementing UI_REFINE is rejected naming the current state and phase.
ui_implementing DONE is treated as a terminal state so the session is archived on advance.

items.name: Add the handoff command
items.description: Add the sub-agent artifact-return command that registers generated files for the current evaluator round and drives the Review prompt, valid only in the three ui_implementing evaluator states.
steps: Create cmd/handoff.go modeled on cmd/adddomain.go: Use "handoff <file> [<file>...]", Args cobra.MinimumNArgs(1), register via init().
Load state; gate to phase ui_implementing and state in {EVALUATE, QA_TEST, E2E_VERIFY}, else error naming current state+phase (exit 1).
os.Stat each argument; a missing file -> error naming the path, register nothing (exit 1).
On success set CurrentBatch.HandedOffArtifacts = args (latest hand-off replaces prior), Save, and print the registered files. No verdict, no transition.
Add command tests for register/Review, outside-state rejection, non-existent-file rejection, and no-args rejection.

tests.description: handoff in QA_TEST with existing files registers them (latest call replaces prior) and a subsequent status shows a Review: line listing them with no verdict recorded.
handoff outside an evaluator state (e.g. UI_REFINE) is rejected naming the current state and phase.
handoff naming a non-existent file, and handoff with no file arguments, are each rejected and register nothing.
